notes.title: Curated Experience Mode is Live
notes.content:
[p]Quality-of-life drop for MiM:[/p][p][b]Curated Experience (new!)[/b]
Answer a few quick questions and MiM will build a session tailored to you—no second-guessing, no menu hopping. Pick your vibe, hit start, and relax.[/p][p][b]Controller D-Pad Support[/b] You can now navigate buttons and menus with the D-Pad. Snappier, cleaner, and way easier with your Steam Deck! (and duh this should've been included at launch)[/p][p]As always, we’d love your feedback—tell us how Curated Experience feels and if D-Pad navigation works smoothly on your setup. Enjoy![/p]

notes.title: Update: Curated Experience Mode + D-Pad Navigation
notes.content:
Quick quality-of-life drop for MiM:

Curated Experience (new!)
Answer a few quick questions and MiM will build a session tailored to you—no second-guessing, no menu hopping. Pick your vibe, hit start, and relax.

Controller D-Pad Support
You can now navigate buttons and menus with the D-Pad. Snappier, cleaner, and way easier from the couch.

As always, we’d love your feedback—tell us how Curated Experience feels and if D-Pad navigation works smoothly on your setup. Enjoy!

notes.title: First Updates in the works!
notes.content: [p]Really excited about the initial purchases, so for all of you that took a chance on MiM, I wanted to extend my humblest gratitude![/p][p]Going to jump in there over the next couple of weeks and tweak a little of this, and thworp a little of that so keep an eye out for that.[/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime please enjoy this fractal fun times.[/p]
